title: Without the Jargon: Agents and Human Authority
markdown:
RED has nine specialists that help the Executive research, structure, produce, govern, execute, measure, and grow client work. Two more capability slots are proposed for future use, but they cannot be routed work or take actions.

Agents prepare analysis and drafts. They do not approve their own work. A named human keeps authority over client decisions, launch, spend, and commitments.

The human roster records who owns each decision and what that person may approve. The agent roster and the human roster have different jobs.
